On experimental tubulin data, blind DIP recovers finer filamentous structures than multi-image deconvolution and DIP with fixed theoretical PSFs, while adapting the PSFs to the measurements.

items.title_en: Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network for Medical Image Segmentation
items.title_zh: 用于医学图像分割的形态感知通道解耦 Mamba 网络
items.abstract_en: Accurate multi-organ segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is essential for computer-aided diagnosis, treatment planning, and disease monitoring. However, substantial variations in organ shape and size, together with low tissue contrast and ambiguous boundaries, complicate the modeling of heterogeneous anatomical structures. To address these challenges, we propose a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled Mamba Network (MCDNet), which integrates adaptive local structural enhancement with channel-decoupled long-range modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Morphology-Aware Channel-Decoupled State-Space (MCSS) block that divides feature channels into separate processing groups, allowing differentiated structural representations to be learned within an efficient state-space framework. Within each group, a Morphology-Aware Enhancement Module (MAEM) combines deformable convolutions with channel attention to adapt local feature extraction to anatomical shape variations. Group-wise state-space modeling then captures long-range spatial dependencies, and channel gating adaptively integrates the resulting features. Experiments on the Synapse abdominal CT dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of MCDNet, achieving an average Dice Similarity Coefficient of 81.61% for multi-organ segmentation.

items.title_en: Uncertainty-aware Coarse-to-Fine Main Pancreatic Duct Segmentation for Width Measurement in 3D MRCP
items.abstract_en: Assessment of the main pancreatic duct (MPD) from volumetric magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) scans is an essential task for ductal dilatation diagnosis and pancreatic cancer analysis. However, manual assessment is affected by reader variability in which automated analysis may assist. Nevertheless, fully automated and uncertainty-aware MPD analysis from volumetric MRCP remains underexplored area of research. In this study, we propose an automatic and uncertainty-aware deep learning-based pipeline for MPD segmentation and maximum-width analysis from MRCP scans. A coarse localisation model first identifies the ductal region-of-interest, followed by a fine model that segments the MPD within the region. The dataset consists of 256 MPD-segmented MRCP scans from 69 patients. A randomly selected holdout test subset of 14 patients with 55 MRCP volumes was used for evaluation. We employed a five-model cross-validation ensemble for improved performance and uncertainty estimation. The best MPD segmentation performance was 0.634 DSC, 0.744 precision, and 0.593 recall. The mean absolute error for maximum MPD width prediction was 0.355~mm and dilated MPD ($\geq 5$~mm) was detected with 75.0\% sensitivity and 74.4\% specificity. These novel results suggest that automated MPD segmentation can be used to aid MRCP-based duct measurements.

items.title_en: BRACHIO: Broad Representations Across Centres for Head-and-neck Imaging Oncology (HECKTOR 2026)
items.title_zh: BRACHIO：用于头颈影像肿瘤学的跨中心广域表征（HECKTOR 2026）
items.abstract_en: The HECKTOR 2026 challenge benchmarks machine learning for head and neck cancer, where teams delineate primary and nodal tumour volumes, perform TN staging, and predict recurrence-free survival (RFS). This report describes the submissions for the HECKTOR challenge of team nucli. As the three tasks span both dense and global information from multicentric PET/CT scans, we utilise self-supervised pre-trained encoders, training a 2D DINOv2 encoder (PET-DINOv2-MIPs) on HECKTOR 2026's PET scans. Our final test submission ensembles a DynUNet trained from scratch with a SwinUNETR whose Swin trunk was initialised from a SimMIM-pre-trained checkpoint for segmentation, reaching a mean Dice of 0.5409. For TN staging, GTVp/GTVn geometric features from the segmentation masks are fit to stage probabilities by logistic regression (LR) and fused with PET-DINOv2-MIPs deep features (PCA + LR) via a second-level LR, reaching balanced accuracies of 0.3962 (T-stage) and 0.6432 (N-stage). For the RFS prognosis task, we fine-tune the last two blocks of the PET-DINOv2-MIPs ViT-S encoder jointly with an MLP head under a CoxPH loss, concatenating clinical covariates with the imaging features, reaching a test Harrell's C-index of 0.6577 and a weighted challenge score of 0.5802. The prognosis result is comparable to the best entry of the previous edition and consistent with our internal cross-validation, while our segmentation result is well below it and limits the staging results that depend on it.

items.title_en: Localizing Concepts in Visual Autoregressive Models
items.abstract_en: Understanding the internal routing of visual concepts is crucial for the safe and controllable adaptation of generative models. While concept localization has been widely studied in diffusion models, the emerging paradigm of next-scale visual autoregressive models remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce LoCo, the first model-agnostic framework to localize where and when specific concepts emerge within autoregressive models. Driven by the native coarse-to-fine nature of next-scale generation, our method precisely maps conceptual knowledge across three distinct dimensions: Layer, Scale, and Position. To systematically localize and evaluate concept routing without context bias, we propose LoCoBench, a comprehensive dataset spanning 10 diverse categories. Extensive probing on image and video autoregressive models like Infinity, HunyuanImage-3.0, and InfinityStar shows that the localized positions are both interpretable and causally related to concept emergence. Building on these insights, we apply our localization method to three key applications: concept erasure, model personalization, and adversarial concept injection. Experiments demonstrate that our targeted intervention achieves state-of-the-art performance, substantially reducing computational overhead while preserving benign utility. Overall, our findings offer insights into how conceptual knowledge is routed during autoregressive generation, introducing a practical pathway for more interpretable, efficient, and secure adaptation.

items.title_en: EPC-RawDC: Equivariant Physics Constrained 3D Diffusion with Raw Data Consistency for CBCT to CT Image Synthesis
items.title_zh: EPC-RawDC：面向 CBCT 到 CT 图像合成的具有原始数据一致性的等变物理约束 3D 扩散
items.abstract_en: Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guided and adaptive radiotherapy, but scatter, noise, reconstruction artifacts, and inaccurate Hounsfield units limit its quantitative use. Recent diffusion approaches for CBCT to CT synthesis remain largely image driven, with limited use of the underlying acquisition physics. We propose EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that combines volumetric generative modeling with two complementary constraints derived from the same scanner specific CBCT forward model. First, geometry equivariant projection constraint exploits the rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator by supervising the synthesized CT through correspondingly transformed reference projections. Second, raw data consistency uses noisy projection measurements of the individual acquisition as scan specific supervision during training. The framework was evaluated on two independent clinical cohorts with distinct scanner geometries and projection sources. For JUST, the physics constraints used measured clinical raw CBCT projections acquired with an Elekta system, whereas for SynthRAD2025 the projection data were simulated from the reference CT using a Varian geometry with Poisson photon statistics. EPC-RawDC achieved an SSIM of 0.97 in both cohorts and improved PSNR over DDPM by 2.66 dB on SynthRAD2025 and 2.10 dB on JUST, while reducing mean MAE by 20.3% and 19.0%, respectively. On SynthRAD2025, projection consistency and equivariant errors were reduced by 55.0% and 41.4% relative to DDPM. These results demonstrate that combining a volumetric diffusion prior with scanner geometry and scan specific projection measurements improves quantitative CBCT to CT synthesis across both simulated and measured projection domains. Code available after publication at https://github.com/ALZAHRAALTALIB/EPC-RawDC.

items.title_en: Segment Anything Model Based Context Guided Mamba Unet for Medical Image Segmentation
items.title_zh: 基于 Segment Anything Model 的上下文引导 Mamba Unet 用于医学图像分割
items.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning, requiring both global contextual understanding and fine-grained structural precision. While the Segment Anything Model (SAM) demonstrates strong generalization capabilities, its direct application to medical images often lacks domain-specific adaptability. Meanwhile, State Space Models (SSMs)-based methods, such as Mamba, efficiently capture long-range dependencies but may struggle with preserving fine anatomical details. To address these challenges, we propose a segment anything model based context guided mamba unet, SAMBA-UNet, a novel framework that integrates SAM's context knowledge with Mamba's hierarchical feature learning to enhance both global representation and local detail refinement. Specifically, we introduce the Hierarchical Context Enhancement Module (HCEM), an attention-based fusion module that deeply incorporates the multi-level features of SAM and Mamba to improve detail perception and segmentation precision. Additionally, we employ LoRA and Adapter-based fine-tuning to adapt SAM to medical imaging tasks, further enhancing its domain-specific segmentation capability and robustness. We conducted a comprehensive study on several medical segmentation datasets, including Synapse, ISIC17, and ISIC18, evaluating our method across multiple metrics. Experimental results demonstrate that SAMBA-UNet achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively balancing generalization, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

items.title_en: DINOv2 for PET: A Pre-Training Domain Benchmark Across Classification, Segmentation, and Prognosis
items.title_zh: DINOv2 用于 PET：跨分类、分割与预后的预训练领域基准
items.abstract_en: DINO (self-DIstillation with NO labels) has become a stan- dard for self-supervised pre-training, producing features that generalise across datasets and downstream tasks. In medical imaging it has been adopted mainly for radiology (X-ray, CT and MRI), where even natural- image DINO features transfer well. In the literature, these features have been reported to transfer worse to functional imaging such as PET. Yet PET-specific DINO models have barely been introduced, and even less validated across multiple tasks and datasets. We present PET-DINOv2-2D, the first DINOv2 model pre-trained on 2D PET, and benchmark it against open-source encoders: the origi- nal DINOv2 (pre-trained on the LVD-142M natural-image dataset) and OmniRad (pre-trained on CT, MRI and ultrasound). Using the same lightweight heads for every backbone, and despite far less pre-training data, PET-DINOv2-2D matches or outperforms both on three down- stream PET tasks: normal/abnormal classification, lesion segmentation and recurrence-free survival prognosis. Its advantage is largest when few labels are available, suggesting that PET pre-training gives more transferable, label-efficient features. Code is made available at https://github.com/nuclivision/pet-dinov2-2d/.

items.title_en: Greenscapes: Optimized Vegetation Configurations in Cities
items.abstract_en: Vegetation plays a central role in cities, serving functional roles such as balancing shade and sky exposure, shaping the microclimate, carbon sequestration, and providing acoustic screening. Furthermore, aesthetic choices in landscape styles (formal, modernist, picturesque) are important for citizens' well-being and should be considered in the design of urban landscapes. In this paper, we present a novel method for placing vegetation, ranging from shrubs to large trees, in 3D urban scenes. Our method uses individual lots as input and employs a conditioned Vision-Language Model (VLM) to generate a top-down rendering of vegetation, placing large trees, small trees, and shrubs on lawn areas. This rendering is then converted into a 3D scene by detecting individual plants and selecting appropriate 3D assets. To refine the proposed configurations, we define an optimization loop that keeps the VLM-generated positions fixed after a deterministic feasibility repair and uses CMA-ES to optimize per-instance scale transformations along with discrete vegetation asset substitutions. To define the objective function for the optimization, we evaluate the generated 3D scenes with efficient surrogate models of shade and path-based acoustic exposure. Furthermore, we render in-scene views at each optimization step to compute view-dependent perceptual descriptors, enabling the generation of both aesthetic and functional vegetation layouts for urban scenes.

items.title_en: How Much Should a VLA Trust Its Reasoning? Step-Level Guidance as a Measured Action-Value Function
items.abstract_en: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) policies write a reasoning trace and then decode the action from it. A wrong trace yields a wrong action, and even a correct-looking trace can mislead the plan. Existing remedies ask whether the reasoning is right. We ask how strongly it should steer. CoC-CFG applies classifier-free guidance between the policy's context and the same context without the reasoning span. One weight per Euler step attenuates or amplifies the reasoning, and w=1 recovers the original policy. We treat the choice of this weight as a Markov decision process whose action values are measured, not bootstrapped. With the expert frozen and the noise fixed, applying a weight for one step and finishing the plan under the current controller returns that weight's value exactly. Q-adaptive guidance fits these values with small critics and improves the controller conservatively. In the Alpasim driving simulator it outperforms every fixed weight and online RL (SAC, GRPO) in open loop, and in closed loop it passes 262 of 300 scenes, against 252 for the original policy. On held-out frames of the Waymo end-to-end driving benchmark, its first three stages outperform every fixed weight, four adaptive-guidance methods, SAC and GRPO. On the hidden test set, a frozen Alpamayo 1.5 with rule-based camera and vehicle conversions and Q-adaptive guidance sets a new state of the art among published methods: 8.135159 rater feedback score, against 8.079 for the best published method.

items.title_en: Mastering Multi-State Dynamics: Continuum Damage and Viscoplastic MPM for RL-Based Dexterous Manipulation
items.title_zh: 驾驭多状态动力学：面向基于强化学习的灵巧操作的连续损伤与粘塑性MPM
items.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation of multi-state materials needs a simulator that handles large deformation, topology change, and two-way contact between tools and materials while staying fast enough to drive online reinforcement learning. We present MG-CD-MPM, a tool-centered localized extension of CD-MPM. The implicit Ginzburg-Landau phase-field damage system is solved on a local patch by preconditioned conjugate gradients using a geometric-multigrid V-cycle as the preconditioner. The background MPM discretization remains uniform: only the damage solve is localized. Two-way rigid-tool coupling converts MPM contact impulses into forces and torques on the tool, exposing material resistance directly to the policy. The resulting Gym-like simulator covers soft solids, brittle materials, granular media, and viscoplastic or semi-fluid media within a unified per-particle constitutive layer. We demonstrate cutting, scooping, and shoveling in six scenes, combining scripted tool motions with PPO policies trained on two cutting tasks.

items.title_en: Blind Video Denoising for Vocal Tract rtMRI using a Self-Supervised Ensemble
items.abstract_en: Real-time magnetic resonance imaging of the vocal tract makes speech articulation directly observable, but the trade-off between temporal resolution and signal quality introduces substantial noise and obscures fine articulatory detail. Since clean references cannot be acquired for a moving vocal tract, supervised denoising approaches are not applicable in this setting. We propose a self-supervised denoising framework that combines spatiotemporal super-resolution learning with pseudo-supervision derived from a variance-stabilized non-local means filter. A dual-model fusion strategy balances noise suppression and preservation of high-frequency articulatory structure. Experiments on the USC-75 multi-speaker dataset under natural noise conditions show that the ensemble raises the signal-to-noise ratio by 11.9 dB on unseen subjects while attaining more high-frequency articulatory content in the frames. Among tuned implementations of anisotropic diffusion, block-matching filtering, non-local means and pre-smoothed non-local means, every configuration that achieves comparable noise suppression does so at the cost of high-frequency content or of structural fidelity. Under severe added Gaussian, Rayleigh and Rician noise, peak signal-to-noise ratio improves by 7.6 to 11.8 dB and structural similarity roughly triples. An ablation shows that the variance-stabilized pseudo-supervision is an essential element for denoising, and that the effect is attributable to the hard thresholding contained in the stabilization transform.

items.title_en: Cross-modal transfer enables zero-shot prediction of drug responses across cell types
items.title_zh: 跨模态迁移实现跨细胞类型的零样本药物响应预测
items.abstract_en: Genetic perturbation responses capture the functional consequences of gene-level interventions, providing functional information for drug-response prediction beyond baseline gene expression. Within the same cellular context, genetic and chemical perturbations engage shared regulatory networks, providing a biological basis for transferring response information between perturbation modalities. Here we introduce GRAFT, a framework that combines genetic-to-chemical transfer with cross-context prediction to infer drug-induced transcriptional responses without drug measurements in the target context. Across benchmarked LINCS and external contexts, GRAFT improved response correlation, directional agreement and magnitude reconstruction over competing methods, particularly for drugs with context-dependent responses. GRAFT-Adapt further refines predictions of unmeasured responses using a small number of drug measurements from the target context. GRAFT-Atlas spans 13 cellular contexts and 7,856 drug catalog entries, comprising 102,128 predictions for drug-context combinations. The atlas captured recognizable pharmacological neighborhoods, shared functional programs, context-dependent transcriptional changes and structural-functional associations supported by molecular docking. Across ten iPSC lines from distinct donors, GRAFT identified candidate inter-donor differences, with functional support for selected candidates from measured genetic perturbation responses. Together, GRAFT enables perturbation-informed prediction and comparison of drug responses across cellular contexts.
items.abstract_zh: 基因扰动响应刻画基因层面干预的功能后果，为超越基线基因表达的药物响应预测提供功能信息。在同一细胞环境中，遗传扰动与化学扰动作用于共享调控网络，这为在扰动模态之间迁移响应信息提供了生物学基础。本文提出GRAFT框架，把遗传到化学的迁移与跨环境预测结合，在目标环境没有药物测量时推断药物诱导的转录响应。在LINCS及外部环境基准上，GRAFT在响应相关性、方向一致性与幅度重建上优于对比方法，对响应依赖细胞环境的药物尤为明显。GRAFT-Adapt利用目标环境的少量药物测量进一步校正未测响应的预测。GRAFT-Atlas覆盖13种细胞环境与7,856条药物目录条目，共102,128条药物-环境组合预测，其中能观察到可辨识的药理邻域、共享功能程序、环境依赖的转录变化以及分子对接支持的结构-功能关联。在来自不同供体的10个iPSC系中，GRAFT识别出候选的供体间差异，并有实测遗传扰动响应为部分候选提供功能支持。
items.highlight_zh: 用遗传扰动迁移补化学扰动，零样本预测跨细胞类型药效
items.digest_zh:
【问题】预测一种药物在某种细胞里会如何改变基因表达（转录响应），传统上必须在那种细胞里实测药物。但很多细胞环境根本没有药物数据，能否借其他信息补上？

【生物学依据】在同一细胞内，基因扰动（如CRISPR筛选）和化学药物扰动作用于同一套调控网络，所以遗传扰动测到的响应信息可以迁移到药物上；同时不同细胞环境之间的响应又如出一辙地存在共性，可再跨环境迁移。

【方法】GRAFT把“遗传→化学”的跨模态迁移与“跨细胞环境”预测结合起来，在目标环境没有药物测量时直接推断药物诱导的转录响应；其扩展版GRAFT-Adapt再用目标环境的少量实测药物数据做校正。作者还构建了GRAFT-Atlas图谱。

【结果】在LINCS及外部基准上，响应相关性、方向一致性和幅度重建均优于对比方法，对行为高度依赖细胞环境的药物提升最明显。GRAFT-Atlas覆盖13种细胞环境、7,856条药物条目，共102,128条预测；其中能看出合理的药理邻域、共享功能程序、环境依赖的转录变化，以及分子对接支持的结构-功能关联。在10个不同供体的iPSC系中，模型给出供体间差异候选，并有实测遗传扰动响应为部分候选提供支持。

【意义】为缺药物数据的细胞环境提供可计算的药效预测与比较，也为“用遗传扰动数据辅助药物筛选”提供了统一框架。

items.title_en: Pycea: a scverse toolkit for single-cell lineage tracing analysis
items.title_zh: Pycea：用于单细胞谱系追踪分析的 scverse 工具包
items.abstract_en: Lineage tracing enables reconstruction of cellular histories in development, regeneration, and disease, but integrating lineage data into single-cell analysis workflows remains challenging. We introduce Pycea, a Python toolkit for lineage analysis and visualization, and TreeData, an extension of AnnData that stores lineage trees alongside cellular measurements. TreeData is compatible with Scanpy and other scverse tools, enabling integrated analysis without converting between formats. Pycea provides scalable methods for tree visualization, clade identification, distance comparisons, ancestral state inference, and lineage statistics. This software is open source and available at https://github.com/YosefLab/pycea.
items.abstract_zh: 谱系追踪可以重建细胞在发育、再生与疾病中的历史，但把谱系数据整合进单细胞分析流程仍然困难。为此，我们推出 Python 工具包 Pycea，用于谱系分析与可视化；同时提出 TreeData，它是 AnnData 的一种扩展，可把谱系树与细胞测量数据一起存储。TreeData 兼容 Scanpy 及其他 scverse 工具，无需在格式之间来回转换即可进行整合分析。Pycea 提供可扩展的方法，涵盖树可视化、进化支（clade）识别、距离比较、祖先状态推断与谱系统计。该软件开源，可在 https://github.com/YosefLab/pycea 获取。
items.highlight_zh: TreeData 让谱系树与单细胞数据同框分析
items.digest_zh: 1）研究了什么问题：谱系追踪能告诉我们在发育、再生和疾病中“哪个细胞来自哪个细胞”，这类信息本质上是一棵树。但树状数据与单细胞转录组等测量数据的存储格式不同，过去分析时往往需要在多套工具之间反复转换，门槛高、易出错。2）用了什么方法：作者开发了 Python 工具包 Pycea，其核心是 TreeData——在单细胞领域通用的 AnnData 数据结构上做扩展，把谱系树和细胞测量值放进同一个对象。因此 Scanpy 等 scverse 生态工具可以直接读取它，无需格式转换。Pycea 同时提供一组可扩展到大规模数据的方法：树的可视化、分支（clade）识别、细胞间距离比较、祖先状态推断以及谱系统计。3）有什么结果：这是一篇软件论文，重点在于接口设计，以及与已有工具链的兼容性和方法覆盖范围；作者以开源形式发布（GitHub: YosefLab/pycea），并未报告具体生物学发现。4）为何重要：它把“细胞之间的谱系关系”变成单细胞分析流程里的一等公民，使研究者可以在同一框架下联合分析树结构与转录组等测量，减少数据搬运带来的错误，也便于不同实验室复用与比较结果，对发育生物学、再生医学和疾病演化研究具有基础设施意义。

items.title_en: Homoharringtonine targets XPC to inhibit DNA damage repair and sensitize tumors to platinum-based chemotherapy
items.title_zh: 高三尖杉酯碱靶向 XPC，抑制 DNA 损伤修复并增敏肿瘤对铂类化疗的响应
items.abstract_en: DNA damage repair (DDR) is essential for preserving genomic stability and also represents a key targetable axis in cancer drug development. Here, we identify and validate homoharringtonine (HHT), a clinically approved antileukemic drug, as a novel DDR inhibitor using a phenotype-driven, high-content screen based on 53BP1 Tudor-domain foci formation. Mechanistically, HHT directly binds XPC, a critical nucleotide excision repair (NER) factor, with high affinity (Kd = 158.4 nM) in a manner dependent on Thr795 of XPC. HHT disrupts XPC-damaged DNA binding, impairs NER, and reduces non-homologous end joining (NHEJ) efficiency. Consequently, HHT sensitizes tumor cells to platinum-based chemotherapy in vitro and in vivo. These findings establish a phenotype-based platform for DDR inhibitor discovery, identify HHT as a first-in-class XPC inhibitor and uncover a previously unrecognized mechanism of HHT that may be exploited to enhance platinum-based therapy in solid tumors.
items.abstract_zh: DNA 损伤修复（DDR）对维持基因组稳定至关重要，也是肿瘤药物开发中的关键可靶向环节。本研究基于 53BP1 Tudor 结构域聚集形成的高内涵表型筛选，发现并验证临床已批准的抗白血病药物高三尖杉酯碱（HHT）是一种新型 DDR 抑制剂。机制上，HHT 以高亲和力（Kd = 158.4 nM）直接结合核苷酸切除修复（NER）关键因子 XPC，且该结合依赖 XPC 的 Thr795。HHT 破坏 XPC 与损伤 DNA 的结合，损害 NER，并降低非同源末端连接（NHEJ）效率；由此在体外与体内使肿瘤细胞对铂类化疗敏感。这些结果建立了基于表型的 DDR 抑制剂发现平台，将 HHT 鉴定为首个 XPC 抑制剂，并揭示了其此前未被认识、可用于增强实体瘤铂类治疗的作用机制。
items.highlight_zh: 老药 HHT 首证为 XPC 抑制剂，增敏铂类化疗
items.digest_zh: 1）研究了什么问题：细胞靠 DNA 损伤修复（DDR）维持基因组稳定，肿瘤细胞也常依赖它抵抗化疗。若能找到新的 DDR 抑制剂，就可让铂类化疗更有效。作者想通过表型筛选找到这类分子，并查清它作用于谁。2）用了什么方法：以 53BP1 蛋白 Tudor 结构域形成聚集灶（foci）作为 DNA 损伤应答的直观读数，建立“表型驱动、高内涵”的筛选体系。筛出的候选是已获批上市的抗白血病老药高三尖杉酯碱（HHT）。随后用结合实验确认分子靶点，并用细胞与动物实验检验联用效果。3）有什么结果：HHT 直接结合核苷酸切除修复（NER）的关键因子 XPC，亲和力很高（Kd = 158.4 nM），且依赖 XPC 上的 Thr795 位点；结合后 HHT 阻断 XPC 与损伤 DNA 的结合。功能上，NER 被削弱，非同源末端连接（NHEJ）效率也下降；因此在体外细胞和体内肿瘤模型中，HHT 都使肿瘤对铂类化疗更敏感。4）为何重要：一是提供了一个可复用的 DDR 抑制剂发现平台；二是把 HHT 定义为首个 XPC 抑制剂（first-in-class），为“老药新用”的联合化疗方案提供了机制依据，提示可用 HHT 增强实体瘤的铂类疗效。

items.title_en: A Multidomain Model for Dementia Classification using Harmonized LASI and LASI-DAD Data
items.title_zh: 基于协调化 LASI 与 LASI-DAD 数据的痴呆分类多域模型
items.abstract_en: Background. Cognitive test performance in India is shaped by education, literacy and language as well as by neurodegeneration, which limits classification based on cognitive tests alone. We examined whether combining cognitive, informant-reported, sociodemographic and cardiometabolic information improves dementia classification, and which domains carry the gain. Methods. We analysed the 2,528 LASI-DAD Wave 1 respondents with a clinical consensus Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR). Dementia was defined as CDR of 1 or above (192 cases, 7.6%). Predictors were eight cognitive measures, the Informant Questionnaire on Cognitive Decline in the Elderly (IQCODE), and age, sex and education. Ten cardiometabolic assays were evaluated in the 1,788 respondents with blood results. Five algorithms were compared using nested cross-validation (5 outer, 3 inner folds). We assessed discrimination, calibration and net benefit, tested each domain's contribution with paired bootstrap differences in ROC-AUC, and examined predictors with permutation importance and SHAP. Results. Logistic regression achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.953 (95% CI 0.937 to 0.966), with calibration intercept 0.00, calibration slope 1.11 and Brier score 0.037. Random forest, gradient boosting and XGBoost performed similarly (0.946 to 0.947). Cognitive measures alone gave a ROC-AUC of 0.899. Adding the IQCODE increased it by 0.052 (95% CI 0.038 to 0.067); adding sociodemographic variables changed it by +0.0020 (-0.00004 to 0.0040) and adding cardiometabolic assays by +0.0032 (-0.0004 to 0.0073). At a training-derived threshold, sensitivity was 0.875, specificity 0.902, positive predictive value 0.422 and negative predictive value 0.989. Observed dementia prevalence rose from 2.1% to 93.5% across five risk strata, and the model gave greater net benefit than referring all or none at every threshold from 0.01 to 0.50. Oversampling with SMOTE did not change discrimination (0.952) but raised mean predicted risk to 21.2% against an observed 7.6%. Conclusions. An interpretable logistic regression model classified clinically rated dementia with high discrimination and good calibration. Its advantage over cognitive tests came almost entirely from informant-reported decline; sociodemographic characteristics and cardiometabolic biomarkers added negligible discrimination. The clinical reference standard incorporated the same informant and cognitive information, and external validation is required before the model is used.

items.title_en: Mapping Individual Neuroanatomical Alterations to Schizophrenia Psychopathology with Normative Modeling
items.title_zh: 利用规范建模将个体神经解剖改变映射到精神分裂症精神病理学
items.abstract_en: Schizophrenia spectrum disorders (SSDs) are clinically and neurobiologically heterogeneous. Normative modeling addresses heterogeneity of structural brain alterations by focusing on individual-level deviations, but their relation to clinical features requires further investigation. We mapped the relationship between individual gray matter volume (GMV) deviations and schizophrenia diagnosis and symptoms. Normative models of GMV were established using cross-sectional, T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging data from a large, multi-site, healthy reference cohort (N = 7957). Deviations were derived for SSD patients (n = 379) and healthy controls (HCs, n = 149). We replicated that SSD is characterized by a more negative global deviation compared to HCs, yet extreme negative deviations exhibit substantial spatial heterogeneity. Regional deviations predicted diagnostic status with adequate performance (AUC = 0.79). A more negative deviation was associated with higher symptom severity and lower cognitive functioning in SSD. Negative deviations were scattered across the brain, with the largest alterations in the salience network. Our findings strengthen the potential of normative modeling to disentangle the heterogeneous underpinnings of SSD and provide further evidence for individualized structural deviations, particularly in the salience network, as promising markers of illness severity in SSDs.

items.title_en: Advancing Clinical Genomic Analysis with a Skill-Centred Agent
items.title_zh: 以技能为中心的智能体推进临床基因组分析
items.abstract_en: Clinical genomic analysis requires experts to integrate evolving guidelines, databases, and computational evidence. As sequencing has become increasingly accessible, this complex and labor-intensive process has become a major bottleneck to the timely use of genomic information in clinical decision-making. To fill this gap, we developed ClinGeX, a large-language-model agent that composes 105 curated executable skills through task-specific retrieval and dependency-aware orchestration. On 223 temporally held-out benchmark cases, ClinGeX achieved 71.7\% macro-averaged task-level concordance with expert reference classifications, compared with 45.7\% for the strongest comparator. In a three-condition, counterbalanced human-AI collaboration study, 45 clinical genomic professionals assessed 135 clinically derived cases under routine (no AI assistance), DeepSeek-assisted and ClinGeX-assisted conditions. ClinGeX assistance increased raw case-level concordance across criterion-level variant analysis, genomic interpretation in rare disease and molecular oncology decision-making (51.1\%, 57.8\%, 64.4\% versus 15.6\%, 31.1\%, 20.0\% in comparator conditions) and reduced reported interpretation time in all scenarios. During an exploratory one-month real-world non-interventional assessment, 11 experienced professionals submitted feedback on 96 self-selected analysis episodes and reported frequent conclusion adoption and time savings. These findings support executable domain skills as a promising approach to augment specialist genomic interpretation.

items.title_en: A heterogenetic theory of living systems
items.title_zh: 生命系统的异质发生理论
items.abstract_en: The problem of the dynamics of living systems and their mathematical representation essentially unfolds on two levels. Firstly, the principles of autopoiesis and operational closure describe how a living system produces and maintains itself. Secondly, living phenomena are recognised as historical, involving the evolution of dynamics and spaces of possibility that change over time. Currently, no differential model can incorporate both of these aspects. We propose adopting the differential heterogenesis framework, which enables us to define differential operators that change in space and time, producing event-based and historical dynamics. In this construction, heterogeneous operator assemblages will be constrained by the principles of autopoiesis and operational closure, providing a theoretical framework for event-based and historical living systems. Finally, we provide a specific example of assembly with Gray-Scott kinetic equations, along with numerical simulations and results.

items.title_en: A Low-Rank Space Captures Linear Alignment Between LLM and Human Neural Activity During Naturalistic Language Listening
items.title_zh: 低秩子空间即可刻画自然语言聆听时 LLM 与人脑神经活动的线性对齐
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as computational models of human language processing, yet it remains unclear which components of their representations drive alignment with neural activity. Here, we use ridge reduced-rank regression to identify the brain-predictive subspace of LLM representations: the representational directions that support linear prediction of neural responses. Across three naturalistic language-listening datasets spanning intracranial electrophysiology and fMRI, and six model conditions spanning autoregressive, bidirectional masked, and randomly initialized language models, we find that full linear encoding performance can be recovered using only 1-3% of the original embedding dimensionality. These low-dimensional subspaces generalize across held-out participants and, to a lesser extent, across datasets, suggesting that neural predictivity is concentrated in a compact and partially shared representational space. We next compare these brain-predictive directions with the principal axes of variation in the embeddings. Principal component analysis requires substantially more dimensions to recover neural prediction, demonstrating that the directions most useful for predicting neural activity are distinct from those capturing the most overall variance within LLM representations themselves. Finally, characterizing the learned subspaces allows us to surface interpretable features that are overrepresented in neural activity above and beyond the LLM representations. Together, these results show that LLM-brain alignment is supported by a small, structured subset of model representations and provides a framework for better understanding exactly why these representations align. Code can be found at: https://github.com/thefinnlab/low-rank-alignment
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）常被用作人类语言加工的计算模型，但究竟哪些表征成分驱动了与神经活动的对齐仍不清楚。我们用岭降秩回归识别 LLM 表征中的“大脑预测子空间”。在三个自然语言聆听数据集（涵盖颅内电生理与 fMRI）和六种模型条件（自回归、双向掩码、随机初始化）下，仅用原嵌入维度的 1–3% 即可恢复完整的线性编码性能；这些低维子空间可泛化到留出被试，跨数据集泛化较弱，提示神经可预测性集中在一个紧凑且部分共享的表征空间。与主成分轴相比，PCA 需多得多的维度才能达到同等预测，说明最能预测神经活动的方向不同于方差最大的方向。刻画这些子空间还揭示了在神经活动中被过度代表的可解释特征。
items.highlight_zh: 1–3% 的维度即可复现 LLM 对大脑的预测能力
items.digest_zh: 1）研究了什么问题：很多研究用大语言模型（LLM）的内部向量去预测人听语言时的脑活动，预测得还不错；但模型向量有几百上千维，我们不知道究竟是哪一小部分真正“对应”大脑，也不知道这种对应是普遍规律还是偶然。2）用了什么方法：作者采用岭降秩回归（ridge reduced-rank regression）：在保持线性预测能力的前提下，主动寻找降维后的“大脑预测子空间”。数据覆盖三个自然语言聆听数据集（含颅内电生理与 fMRI 两类记录）；模型侧覆盖六种条件：自回归模型、双向掩码模型，以及随机初始化的模型作为对照。随后把找到的方向与嵌入本身的主成分轴（PCA）作对比。3）有什么结果：仅保留原始嵌入维度的 1–3%，就足以达到完整线性编码的预测性能；这些低维子空间能迁移到未参与拟合的新被试，跨数据集迁移则弱一些，说明该子空间紧凑、且被试间部分共享。PCA 需要远多的维度才能达到同样效果，说明“最能预测大脑的方向”并不等于“方差最大的方向”。此外分析这些子空间还找出了相对模型表征而言被神经活动额外放大的可解释特征。4）为何重要：它把“LLM 与人脑对齐”从一个笼统的相似性说法，变成了一个结构清晰、可检验的小子空间问题，有助于回答“为什么会对齐”，也为比较不同模型与脑数据的对应关系提供了可复用工具（代码已开源）。

items.title_en: Learning developmental dynamics from lineage context
items.title_zh: 从谱系上下文学习发育动力学
items.abstract_en: A central goal of biology is to predict the dynamics of multicellular systems. Lineage context (the states of a cell's sisters, cousins, etc.) could inform these predictions, but how best to leverage it remains unclear. Here we introduce lineage inpainting, a generative modeling approach that uses lineage context with tree-structured transformers and stochastic interpolants to model cell state dynamics across lineage trees. Applied to a lineage-traced transcriptional atlas of mouse embryogenesis, it recovers dynamics not resolved by gene expression alone, including multiple transcriptional convergence events where distinct lineages are drawn to a common state. Despite being fit on unperturbed development, lineage inpainting can generate hypotheses about perturbation responses by simulating counterfactuals. These simulations agree in many cases with observed developmental phenotypes, including a single-cell measurement of the Tbx5 knockout response. Our results show that lineage information provides a rich source of context for learning multicellular dynamics.

items.title_en: Yoga biomechanics through energy optimization: diverse kinematics and low-dimensional kinetics
items.title_zh: 通过能量优化的瑜伽生物力学：多样运动学与低维动力学
items.abstract_en: Yoga is widely practiced for improving physical and mental health, yet the biomechanical demands of individual yoga poses remain poorly characterized. Existing experimental studies typically examine only a small number of poses or muscles, limiting their ability to guide pose selection for rehabilitation or exercise prescription. Here we present a computational framework for predicting whole-body joint torques and contact forces from two-dimensional images of yoga poses. The framework combines manual pose digitization, a sagittal-plane MuJoCo human model, and constrained metabolic energy minimization subject to static equilibrium. We applied the framework to 55 sagittally symmetric yoga poses from Light on Yoga, generating a dataset of joint kinematics, contact locations, and predicted joint torques and contact forces. These poses collectively span nearly the full physiological range of motion of the major joints while exhibiting a wide range of predicted joint torques, with the greatest average demands on the lower extremities and lumbar region. Principal component analysis revealed a striking contrast between kinematics and kinetics: nearly all ten dimensions were required to represent the joint-angle data, whereas the first three principal components captured over 90% of the variance in joint torques. Thus, yoga poses exhibit substantial diversity in body configurations but comparatively low-dimensional patterns of predicted joint loading. Predicted joint torque rankings were also largely insensitive to uncertainty in the relative weighting of joint metabolic costs. This framework enables systematic biomechanical analysis of yoga poses and provides a foundation for quantitatively evaluating their mechanical demands and informing future rehabilitation strategies.

items.title_en: Agentic LLM reasoning in pediatric diabetes outcome prediction from multimodal medical records
items.title_zh: 基于多模态医疗记录的儿童糖尿病结局预测中的智能体式 LLM 推理
items.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are proposed for clinical prediction but are untested in pediatrics, where cohorts are small and outcomes are uncommon. Using records from 2,489 youth with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and 4,018 with type 1 diabetes (T1D), spanning structured data, note-derived social determinants and, in T1D, continuous glucose monitoring data, we predicted seven T2D outcomes, four also in T1D, at 24 months from 18 months of follow-up. CEDAR (Clinical Evidence-Driven Agent for Risk-prediction), an evidence-citing, self-auditing LLM pipeline, outperformed trained machine learning in both cohorts (pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.815 versus 0.656 to 0.700 in T2D and 0.756 versus 0.603 to 0.631 in T1D), most on the sparsely screened outcomes. Only 4 of 70,246 values it cited did not match the chart. Reading only the evidence and reasoning cited by CEDAR, two pediatric endocrinologists reached the same prediction as CEDAR in about nine of ten cases, agreeing with each other on 90.5%.

items.title_en: Latent Prediction Yields Cross-Subject Alignable Representations in Sensory-Evoked fMRI
items.title_zh: 潜在预测在感觉诱发 fMRI 中产生跨被试可对齐表征
items.abstract_en: Decoding sensory-evoked functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data is a central analytical tool in cognitive neuroscience. Here we ask whether self-supervised learning (SSL), which has been scarcely explored in this domain, can yield representations that support strong downstream performance. To do so, we adapt a joint embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) to train participant-specific encoders on brain data alone. The encoders never see the stimulus images or any representation derived from them. Applied to the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD), we evaluate our learned brain embeddings on the downstream tasks of brain captioning and image reconstruction, as well as cross-participant generalization. Our self-supervised approach achieves competitive performance with parameter-rich supervised pipelines that are trained end-to-end with access to image and language data. We further find that encoders trained independently for different participants can be aligned fully unsupervised, using neither images nor stimuli shared between them. After alignment, a neural decoding head trained on one participant can be applied to another without fine-tuning and retains most of its within-subject performance on image reconstruction and brain captioning. By removing the need for images and shared stimuli, our approach is a step towards pooling fMRI data across participants and, eventually, across datasets.

items.title_en: PCR-ALERA: A PCR-ELISA analogue but antibody-free DNA detection system
items.title_zh: PCR-ALERA：一种类似 PCR-ELISA 但无需抗体的 DNA 检测系统
items.abstract_en: PCR-ALERA is a new concept for DNA detection that combines DNA amplification by polymerase chain reaction (PCR) with an activator-linked enzyme reactivation assay (ALERA). PCR-ALERA resembles the commercial, semi-quantitative PCR-ELISA assay that offers high sensitivity and high-throughput screening in microplates. PCR-ALERA overcomes a major drawback of PCR-ELISA since it does not require the time-consuming handling of expensive antibodies. In the first step of the assay, commercially available modified nucleotides were incorporated during PCR amplification of the target DNA. A selenocysteine containing peptide (the activator) was linked to the amplified DNA by click chemistry. This peptide has been optimized for the highly efficient activation of the latent protease papain by selenolate-triggered disulfide cleavage. The DNA-peptide hybrid was then immoblized in microplate wells and incubated with latent papain. The latter was readily activated and converted a fluorogenic substrate to a fluorescent product with high catalytic turnover. Overall assay time is about 4 hours including PCR.

items.title_en: Beyond $χ^2$: Ensemble null tests for reliable scientific discovery
items.title_zh: 超越 $χ^2$：面向可靠科学发现的系综零检验
items.abstract_en: Unrecognized systematic errors can survive standard checks and undermine scientific discoveries. Null tests and experimental controls can expose these failures, but averaging measurements or reducing them to scalar statistics can hide important structure. We propose ensemble null tests that compare multivariate distributions with references from observations or simulations. We demonstrate their benefits across science. In cosmic microwave background simulations, they detect systematic effects missed by conventional $χ^2$ tests. In Gaia data, they detect velocity asymmetry as sensitively as an informed search. In a CRISPR screen, they expose a control mismatch in DNA damage and reveal which cellular profiles drive it. As scientific datasets grow, ensemble testing turns repeated measurements into a broader search for unknown unknowns, strengthening the empirical foundation for scientific discovery.

items.title_en: The Verification Wall in Microbial Metabolomics
items.title_zh: 微生物代谢组学中的验证壁垒
items.abstract_en: Computational methods now propose structures for gut microbial metabolites faster than any laboratory can confirm them. We argue that verification, not generation, is the binding constraint, and that better models will not relieve it. Confirming a structure to the field's own standard means having the molecule in hand. Automation can lower what that costs per compound, but the cost stays proportional to the number of structures and never amortizes across them. Two substitutes are on offer and neither removes that requirement. In-silico spectral prediction ranks candidates instead of confirming one, and the strongest current model puts the right structure first 33.5% of the time on a scaffold-split benchmark. Any assignment resting on spectral similarity is, by the field's own definition, made without a reference standard. Microcrystal diffraction does return a structure, but it needs the compound to crystallize out of a trace mixture, which is a different problem rather than an easier one. We sorted 10,645 computationally inferred metabolite structures by what verifying each would take. Between 5% and 37% have no verification route identified under our analysis. That spread reflects where the thresholds are set rather than a measured count of unverifiable compounds, and the inaccessible ones cluster among the most speculative entries. Those figures understate the problem, because the gut makes far more compounds than any database records. HMDB holds only what someone has already thought worth cataloguing, and structure generators are bounded by nothing at all. The claim is easy to disprove. Show a route that confirms structures as fast as they are proposed. Until someone does, two problems stay unsolved. Nobody knows how to spend a verification budget that will always be too small, or what a biologist may conclude from a structure that was never confirmed.

items.title_en: Reconstructing hidden observables via quantum snapshot thermometry
items.title_zh: 用“量子快照测温”重建隐藏的可观测量
items.abstract_en: Projective snapshots are a standard readout tool for quantum simulators, but they directly probe only observables that are diagonal in the measurement basis. We show how local equilibration and an independently calibrated equilibrium equation of state can reveal otherwise hidden conserved-density profiles. We demonstrate numerically that such ``quantum snapshot thermometry'' can recover energy fronts and a diffusion constant, distinguish spin transport from energy spreading, and reveal conserved-charge profiles invisible in the initial measurements. We also identify symmetry-imposed ambiguities in the readout and show how prior knowledge of the spatial structure can resolve them. Fixed-basis snapshot thermometry thus provides quantitative hydrodynamic information beyond transport exponents, bypassing additional measurement bases and quantum state tomography.
items.abstract_zh: 投影快照是量子模拟器的标准读出手段，但它只能直接探测在测量基下对角的可观测量。我们展示：局域热化，再加上一个独立标定的平衡态物态方程，能够揭示原本隐藏的守恒密度剖面。数值实验表明，这种“量子快照测温”可以恢复能量前沿与扩散常数，区分自旋输运与能量扩散，并揭示在初始测量中不可见的守恒荷分布。我们还指出由对称性造成的读出歧义，并说明如何利用空间结构的先验知识加以消解。因此，固定基快照测温能绕过额外测量基与量子态层析，提供超越输运指数的定量流体力学信息。
items.highlight_zh: 固定基快照测温可反推隐藏的守恒密度剖面
items.digest_zh: 1）研究了什么问题：量子模拟器常用“投影快照”来读出体系状态，做法是反复测量并统计结果。但这种测量只能看到与测量基“对得上”（即在该基下对角）的量，像能量、粒子数这类守恒量在空间中的分布若不在这个基下，就看不见，即所谓隐藏可观测量。2）用了什么方法：作者提出“量子快照测温”。它依据两个前提：其一，体系内部会局域热化，因此局部小块可近似视为处于某个平衡态；其二，事先用别的方式独立标定出平衡态物态方程（温度或化学势与密度的对应关系）。这样，从固定基下的快照统计中就能反推出局域的能量或电荷密度，进而重建空间剖面。3）有什么结果：数值模拟显示，该方法能重建“能量前沿”的空间形状并提取扩散常数；能区分自旋输运与能量扩散这两种物理过程；还能给出初始测量中完全不可见的守恒荷分布。作者同时指出，体系对称性会导致读出存在歧义（不同剖面给出相同快照统计），但若已知空间结构的先验信息，例如边界条件或单调性，就可以消解歧义。4）为何重要：通常要获取这些流体力学层面的信息，需要切换多个测量基甚至做量子态层析，实验代价极高；该方法只用现有的固定基快照数据，就能得到超越“输运指数”的定量信息，让量子模拟实验的数据利用率显著提升。

items.title_en: Renormalization for Robust Memory without Synchronization
items.title_zh: 无需同步的鲁棒记忆重整化
items.abstract_en: Local error correction can preserve classical information against noise, but protection under synchronized updates need not survive when sites evolve at independent random times. Establishing stability is particularly challenging when protection relies on the collective action of competing local rules. Here we develop a spacetime renormalization framework that reveals how independently acting local updates can collectively stabilize memory. We identify sufficient conditions under which the geometry of stable interfaces and suppression of defect propagation produce reliable erosion at large scales. Applying this framework, we prove stability of the asynchronous \textsf{R} squeezing code and introduce robust processes in two and three dimensions. In these systems, both encoded phases persist under sufficiently weak noise, even when the noise favors one phase. Our results provide a criterion for designing autonomous memories sustained by competing local stochastic dynamics.
items.abstract_zh: 局部纠错能在噪声下保护经典信息，但当各站点在相互独立的随机时刻演化、而非同步更新时，这种保护未必成立；尤其当保护依赖多条相互竞争的局部规则的集体作用时，稳定性更难确立。我们建立了一个时空重整化框架，揭示独立作用的局部更新如何集体地稳定记忆，并给出充分条件：稳定界面的几何结构与缺陷传播的抑制，可在宏观尺度上产生可靠的信息侵蚀。据此我们证明了异步 R squeezing 码的稳定性，并在二维与三维中构造出鲁棒过程；在这些系统中，即使噪声偏向某一相，两个编码相在足够弱的噪声下都能持续存在。该结果为设计由竞争性局部随机动力学维持的自主记忆提供了判据。
items.highlight_zh: 时空重整化证明异步局部纠错可稳定记忆
items.digest_zh:
研究的问题：量子纠错与记忆保护通常默认所有比特同步更新，但真实的存储器件中，各站点是在随机、独立的时间点被噪声击中。已有证明多依赖同步更新，异步情形下信息能否保住并不清楚，尤其当保护靠几条互相竞争的局部规则共同作用时。

方法：作者建立「时空重整化」框架，把系统的时空演化按尺度逐级粗粒化，追踪稳定界面（不同编码相之间的边界）的几何形态以及缺陷的传播方式。

结果：给出充分条件——若稳定界面几何足够规则、缺陷传播被抑制，则大尺度上噪声会被可靠地「侵蚀」掉。据此严格证明异步 R squeezing 码稳定，并在二维、三维构造出新的鲁棒过程；即使噪声本身偏向某个相，两个编码相在弱噪声下都能存活。

为何重要：说明无需全局时钟同步，仅靠竞争性的局部随机更新即可自维持记忆，为设计自主运行的存储与纠错方案提供了可操作判据。

items.title_en: Comparison of entangling strategies for unitary synthesis
items.title_zh: 用于酉合成的纠缠策略比较
items.abstract_en: Trapped-ion quantum computers are promising as a platform for realizing quantum computational advantage. They promise long coherence times, near all-to-all connectivity, and potential multiqubit gates as distinguishing advantages compared to competing platforms. Regarding these advantages, it is crucial to understand the trade-offs between increasing engineering complexity and actual improvements in running quantum algorithms with a more flexible gate set. In this work, we investigate this question and develop a versatile toolset to evaluate the performance of gate sets composed of native Mølmer--Sørensen multiqubit gates. To this end, we employ unitary synthesis as an application-agnostic benchmark target and identify specific hardware requirements for multiqubit gates to be advantageous.
items.abstract_zh: 离子阱量子计算机是实现量子计算优势的有力平台，具有长相干时间、近乎全连接的耦合，并有望以多比特门作为区别于其他平台的独特优势。因此必须理解：增加工程复杂度与采用更灵活门集合实际运行量子算法所带来的收益之间如何权衡。本文围绕这一问题，建立了一套通用工具集，用于评估由原生 Mølmer–Sørensen 多比特门构成的门集合的性能。作者以酉合成这一与具体应用无关的任务作为基准目标，并识别出多比特门要真正带来优势所需的特定硬件条件。
items.highlight_zh: 给出多比特门要带来优势的硬件门槛
items.digest_zh:
研究的问题：离子阱平台具有长相干时间、近乎全连接的耦合，还可能支持多比特门。但门集合越灵活，工程复杂度越高；这种额外复杂度究竟值不值？本文用一个统一标准来量化这笔权衡。

方法：作者把「酉合成」——即把任意目标量子操作分解为硬件原生门序列——当作与具体应用无关的基准任务，搭建了一套通用工具集，评估由原生 Mølmer–Sørensen 多比特门组成的门集合的表现。

结果：通过系统比较不同纠缠策略（直接用多比特门，还是拆成两比特门组合等）在合成酉操作时的代价，作者刻画了各自的优劣，并指出多比特门要真正胜出所必须满足的特定硬件要求，例如门保真度、速度或连通性方面的门槛。

为何重要：这给实验者指明了方向：盲目堆叠更复杂的多比特门不一定划算，只有当关键硬件指标达标时优势才会显现，从而帮助把工程投入用在最有效的地方。

items.title_en: Entanglement diagnostics of stochastic-resetting steady states: theory and measurement on superconducting qubits
items.title_zh: 随机重置稳态的纠缠诊断：理论及在超导量子比特上的测量
items.abstract_en: Stochastic resetting drives quantum systems into nonequilibrium stationary states unreachable under uninterrupted unitary evolution, and their entanglement depends on whether the reset history is resolved or averaged over. We study this interplay in the transverse-field Ising chain, deriving closed-form results for two qubits and evaluating chains of up to 12 qubits exactly. In the two-qubit system, these closed-form results show that phase matching between energy eigenstates produces resonances, and their visibility in the stationary state is determined by the symmetry of the reset state. Measurements on an IBM superconducting processor show the entropies evaluated before and after the reset average closely following noiseless predictions with no fitted parameter, while concurrence lies below prediction across most of the hardware measurements. The two diagnostics respond differently because they read different components of the same reconstructed state, and a depolarizing model captures the concurrence suppression with one fitted parameter. The difference between the two entropies, i. e., the Jensen gap of entanglement entropy, equals the Holevo information that a subsystem retains about the time since the last reset. With a Bell-state reset, this information grows with chain length across a half-chain cut over the sizes studied, without visible saturation at the smaller reset probabilities. Since reset times are sampled and recorded classically, the trajectory-averaged entropy, and with it the Jensen gap, is obtained without postselection, in contrast to monitored circuits, where trajectory-resolved entanglement requires sampling exponentially rare measurement records.

items.title_en: Locality in Dissipative Ground-State Preparation
items.title_zh: 耗散基态制备中的局域性
items.abstract_en: Can the ground state of a local Hamiltonian be prepared by local dissipation? We address this question for free-fermion Hamiltonians, using a quadratic Lindbladian with linear jump operators for the dissipative ground-state preparation. For translation-invariant targets, Fourier correspondence relates spatial locality to momentum-space analyticity, allowing us to derive a complete spectral criterion for the existence of exponentially local linear jump operators that prepare the ground state. This criterion leads to a no-go theorem that, sign-changing Fermi-level crossings exclude exponentially local linear jump operators for preparing the ground state. While these crossings are the complete obstruction in one dimension, additional obstructions generally arise in higher dimensions. We illustrate these additional obstructions using two quadratic-band-touching models with algebraically decaying ground-state correlations. We further show that short-range ground-state correlations, although not necessary, are sufficient for local dissipative preparation even without translation invariance. Our results establish how the spectral structure of the target Hamiltonian governs the locality of dissipative ground-state preparation.

items.title_en: Left-Handed Transmission Lines for the Dynamical Casimir Effect
items.title_zh: 用于动态卡西米尔效应的左手传输线
items.abstract_en: Left-handed (LH) superconducting transmission lines, built with series capacitors and shunt inductors instead of the series inductors and shunt capacitors of a conventional right-handed (RH) line, have a spectrum with a nonzero lower band edge and modes that become sparse at high frequencies. We study the dynamical Casimir effect in a LH line terminated by a flux-modulated SQUID and compare it with an RH line built from the same elements and with a long coplanar waveguide terminated by the same SQUID. We derive the quantum Hamiltonian and show that the coupling between two modes factorizes into their amplitudes at the SQUID. Together, the LH spectrum and the mode dependence of this coupling determine which modes are populated and how fast. With equal elements, the LH coupling grows with frequency and exceeds the RH one above a crossover pump frequency set by the cell inductance and capacitance, and only the LH line has resonances above the RH band edge. Pumping two modes at once lets a weakly coupled mode borrow coupling from a strongly coupled one, while crossings of resonance lines populate three or four modes without increasing the growth rate. Compared with the coplanar waveguide, the LH line has a similar coupling but keeps the created particles in the target mode, whereas the nearly equidistant waveguide spreads them over many pairs and needs more pump energy.

items.title_en: Optimal Diamond Distance Estimation for Unitary Channels
items.title_zh: 酉信道的最优菱形距离估计
items.abstract_en: The diamond distance between two quantum channels determines the optimal probability of distinguishing them from a single use. We give a quantum algorithm that estimates the diamond distance between two unknown $d$-dimensional unitary channels to within additive error $\varepsilon$, using $O(\sqrt{d}/\varepsilon)$ queries to the unitary channels and their inverses. The query complexity is optimal, as it matches the lower bound due to Jeon and Oh (npj Quantum Inf. 2026).

items.title_en: Exceptional Points as Witnesses of Non-Gaussian Noise
items.title_zh: 例外点作为非高斯噪声的见证者
items.abstract_en: Efficient control of quantum devices requires the knowledge of their environmental noise, yet the commonly measured power spectrum does not fully characterize non-Gaussian fluctuations of realistic environments. Here we show that exceptional points (EPs) in the noise-averaged dephasing response can expose observable signatures of non-Gaussian statistics, distinguishing environments with identical lower-order statistics. We also introduce a theoretical model that describes dephasing environments in terms of identical independent noise sources while preserving the power spectrum. Given a calibrated single-source model, the largest EP order extracted from the measured dephasing response determines the number of sources and predicts the higher-order statistics of the combined noise. We illustrate an atomtronic readout that maps distinct EP signatures onto an evolving ensemble-averaged atomic interference pattern. Our results connect non-Hermitian dynamics to environmental noise statistics, providing a route to characterize noise in quantum devices used in computing, metrology, and precision measurement.

items.title_en: Algebraic theory of abelian fractons and beyond
items.title_zh: 阿贝尔分形子的代数理论及其拓展
items.abstract_en: We develop an algebraic theory of fusion, mobility, and statistics in abelian gapped fracton orders and topological phases. The framework generalizes the algebraic description of abelian anyons to systems with restricted-mobility and spatially extended excitations. We consider translation-invariant bosonic systems whose pointlike and extended excitations have finite fusion order. The basic objects are braided fusion complexes (BFCs): chain complexes encoding fusion and mobility, equipped with a braiding chain map encoding statistics. Their equivalence classes define braided fusion theories (BFTs). Our framework encompasses arbitrary translation-invariant Pauli codes, as well as all abelian anyon theories in two spatial dimensions, including chiral theories. We give evidence for the conjecture that every nondegenerate BFT can be realized as the excitation theory of a gapped phase and that the BFT describing such a phase is a phase invariant. We derive constraints on pointlike fusion and mobility, showing, for example, that neither the Pauli X nor Z sectors of the X-cube and anisotropic models can occur alone in a nondegenerate BFT. For nondegenerate theories with only pointlike excitations, we extract a simpler theory of mutual statistics, consisting of a fusion module and a map to its statistical dual. This theory of mutual statistics is an invariant of the BFT and, at odd fusion order, gives an equivalent description of the full braided fusion theory. We interpret remote detection as the generalization of mutual statistics to fracton orders. In the BFC setting, we give a precise formulation of the excitation-detector principle: every nontrivial excitation can be detected by an operator supported at spatial infinity, and every nontrivial detector detects some excitation. Assuming a unique infinite-space ground state, we prove that this principle is equivalent to nondegeneracy.

items.title_en: Optimal detuning and gate time for strongly driven single-qubit gates beyond the rotating-wave approximation
items.title_zh: 超越旋转波近似下强驱动单量子比特门的最优失谐与门时间
items.abstract_en: Single-qubit quantum gates are implemented as the time-controlled unitary evolution of a two-level system under harmonic driving. The rotating-wave approximation (RWA) provides closed-form gate parameters for weak coupling. Larger amplitudes, desirable to speed up the dynamics, make the RWA-designed gates inaccurate because of the neglected counter-rotating term, which also shifts the resonance (Bloch-Siegert shift). Here we study theoretically the infidelity of gates beyond the RWA, using the effective Magnus-Taylor Hamiltonian through second order in the inverse of the driving frequency. By detuning the driving frequency by an amplitude-dependent shift of Bloch-Siegert type and rescaling the operation time, the RWA gate conditions are recovered with corrected parameters. Numerical solutions of the Schrodinger equation show that these corrections lower the gate infidelity by several orders of magnitude, extending the range of usable amplitudes

items.title_en: Probing fluctuations in photon emission statistics of spin injected quantum dots with time dependent electronic excitation
items.title_zh: 时变电激发下自旋注入量子点光子发射统计涨落的探测
items.abstract_en: Electrically spin-injected ensembles of InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots emit circularly polarized single photons, with the emission helicity determined by the spin polarization of the injected electrons. A ferromagnetic CoFeB spin-injection layer with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, combined with an MgO tunnel barrier, enables spin-polarized electron injection into the quantum-dot active region, resulting in circularly polarized photon emission at zero applied magnetic field. These devices realize direct spin-charge-photon conversion in an electrically driven, microelectronics-compatible quantum light source that operates without an external pump laser. Using an extended Hanbury Brown-Twiss interferometer with four detectors and time-tagged readout, we measure time-resolved photon-number statistics that resolve up to $|2\rangle$ Fock states within a single excitation cycle. While single-photon ($n=|1\rangle$) emission tracks the electrical excitation pulse as expected, the two-photon ($n=|2\rangle$) statistics exhibit pronounced fluctuations at multiple temporal positions within the pulse. These fluctuations vanish upon demagnetization of the spin-injection layer, establishing a direct link between the multi-photon emission dynamics and the spin polarization of the injected carriers. The observations indicate that spin injection controls not only the helicity of the emitted photons but also higher-order temporal correlations of the emission. The behavior is phenomenologically captured by inserting both a variable excitation mechanism and a set of multi-emitter collapse operators within a stochastic wave function evolution. The platform thus opens a route to electrically driven, spin-controlled single and multi-photon Fock-state sources and provides a testbed for spin-conditioned multi-emitter dynamics in solid-state quantum light sources.
items.abstract_zh: 电自旋注入的 InGaAs/GaAs 量子点系综发射圆偏振单光子，其螺旋度由注入电子的自旋极化决定。具有垂直磁各向异性的 CoFeB 铁磁注入层与 MgO 隧穿势垒结合，可在零外加磁场下实现自旋极化注入，从而在电驱动、与微电子工艺兼容、无需外部泵浦激光的器件中实现自旋–电荷–光子直接转换。利用带时间标记读出的四探测器扩展 Hanbury Brown–Twiss 干涉仪，我们测得时间分辨的光子数统计，可在单个激发周期内分辨至 |2⟩ 福克态。单光子（n=1）发射随电激发脉冲变化符合预期，而双光子（n=2）统计在脉冲内多个时间位置出现显著涨落；自旋注入层退磁后涨落消失，表明多光子发射动力学与注入载流子自旋极化直接相关。这些行为可用引入可变激发机制与多发射体坍缩算符的随机波函数演化唯象描述。
items.highlight_zh: 自旋注入同时控制光子螺旋度与高阶时间关联
items.digest_zh:
研究的问题：能否用纯电驱动的方式做出自旋可控的单光子乃至多光子福克态光源，并看清其发射统计随时间的涨落？

方法：器件为 InGaAs/GaAs 量子点系综，通过 CoFeB（垂直磁各向异性）/MgO 隧道结注入自旋极化电子，零外磁场下即可发出圆偏振光子，无需外部泵浦激光。作者用四探测器、带时间标记的扩展 Hanbury Brown–Twiss 干涉仪测量时间分辨的光子数统计。

结果：单光子（n=1）发射与电激发脉冲同步，符合预期；但双光子（n=2）统计在脉冲内多个时刻出现明显涨落。将自旋注入层退磁后涨落消失，说明多光子动力学与注入载流子的自旋极化直接挂钩。作者用引入可变激发机制与多发射体坍缩算符的随机波函数演化，唯象地重现了该行为。

为何重要：表明自旋注入不只决定光子偏振，还调控更高阶的时间关联；该平台可作为自旋条件下的多光子量子光学测试床，并为电驱动、自旋控制的福克态光源铺路。

items.title_en: Toric codes all the way down: decoupling translation-invariant topological CSS codes in higher dimensions
items.title_zh: 环面码一路到底：解耦高维平移不变拓扑 CSS 码
items.abstract_en: Topological Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) codes in more than two spatial dimensions offer features useful for fault-tolerant quantum computation, such as transversal non-Clifford gates and single-shot decoding, but a systematic understanding of them is still lacking. One approach is to decouple a code: map it to a stack of higher-form toric codes by a finite-depth local CSS-preserving Clifford circuit, possibly after adding ancillas. For translation-invariant $p$-ary CSS codes, where $p$ is prime ($p=2$ for qubits), we require the circuit to commute with the translations of a superlattice. In two dimensions, such a decoupling exists once these translations act trivially on every anyon type. In higher dimensions, excitations are sorted by their dimension into superselection layers, which can remain glued together even when translations act trivially on each layer. We show that this gluing is the only remaining obstruction: a code can be decoupled on a superlattice exactly when, after coarse-graining to it, translations act trivially on every layer and the gluing vanishes. Moreover, for a code with finitely many excitation types in each layer and $m$ nonzero layers, once translations act trivially on every layer, further coarse-graining by a factor of $p^{m-1}$ in every direction removes the aforementioned gluing. Physically, the same criterion determines when the code encodes the maximal number of logical qudits on a finite torus. Finally, we give an explicit algorithm that constructs the decoupling as a circuit of SUM (qudit CNOT) and SWAP gates.

items.title_en: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
items.title_zh: 面向固态量子自旋自主实验研究的协作式 AI 智能体
items.abstract_en: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess one another's work and can stop or redirect investigations. They can generate and reject research questions, require separate theoretical checks and conduct experiments designed to challenge their claims. We demonstrate these capabilities by investigating ensembles of quantum spins in diamond. The agents derived the minimum number of calibration settings needed to predict responses to a defined family of microwave pulse sequences. They checked the result computationally and designed experiments to distinguish competing predictions. An initial experiment agreed with the theoretical predictions, but repeated reference measurements showed that the signal was drifting during data collection. The agents therefore treated the result as inconclusive and revised the measurement protocol without relaxing the acceptance criteria. The revised experiment met those criteria and supported the theoretical predictions. This study demonstrates that collaborating AI agents can select research questions, derive theoretical results and test their predictions experimentally.
items.abstract_zh: 自主实验室有望完成从提出问题到撰写论文的完整研究流程，人工智能是实现这一目标的可能途径。近期 AI 系统已承担若干科研角色，却可能得出证据并不支持的结论。我们展示了一个自主研究实验室：基于大语言模型的智能体互相评估彼此工作，并可中止或改变研究方向；它们能生成与否决研究问题、要求独立的理论校验，并设计实验来挑战自身主张。我们以金刚石中的量子自旋系综演示这些能力：智能体推导出预测某类微波脉冲序列响应所需的最少校准设置数，用计算加以核验，并设计实验区分相互竞争的预测。首次实验与理论一致，但重复参考测量显示采集期间信号存在漂移，智能体因此将结果判为不确定，并在不放宽验收标准的前提下修订测量方案；修订后的实验满足标准并支持理论预测。
items.highlight_zh: AI 智能体互相审查，拒绝不合证据的结论
items.digest_zh:
研究的问题：能否让 AI 智能体跑完一个完整的研究闭环——提出问题、推导理论、做实验、判断结果是否可信，而不是自信地给出证据并不支持的结论？

方法：作者搭建了一个自主实验室，其中多个基于大语言模型的智能体分工协作并互相评审，可以否决研究问题、叫停或改道实验、要求独立的理论校验，并主动设计能证伪自身主张的实验。测试对象是金刚石中的量子自旋系综，研究其对微波脉冲序列的响应。

结果：智能体推导出预测给定一族微波脉冲序列响应所需的最少校准设置数目，用计算进行核验，并设计了能区分竞争性预测的实验。首次实验与理论一致，但重复的参考测量显示采集期间信号在漂移；智能体据此把结果判为不确定，并在不放宽验收标准的情况下改进测量方案，改进后的实验通过标准并支持理论预测。

为何重要：这表明 AI 智能体可自主选题、推导并实验验证；关键在于内置的相互审查与自我质疑机制，这正是防止 AI 科研「过度自信」的核心设计。

items.title_en: Classical communication over quantum channels: does entanglement help in nature?
items.title_zh: 量子信道上的经典通信：纠缠在自然界中有帮助吗？
items.abstract_en: Can entangling codewords across independent uses of a quantum channel improve the rate of classical communication? An old conjecture states that there is no such entanglement advantage for all channels. Although Hastings's result and follow-up works disproved this conjecture, it turns out that enormous dimension is required to construct a channel where entanglement enhances classical communication. This indicates that there might be no entanglement advantage for many physical channels, or for all low dimensional channels. Motivated by recent progress on (generalized) amplitude damping channels, we propose a general Schur-weighted block entropy inequality, and show that there is no entanglement advantage for all phase-covariant channels including multi-level amplitude damping channels, generalized dephasing channels, and damping-dephasing channels. As a by-product, we also recover the recently established result that there is no entanglement advantage for all qubit channels.

items.title_en: What Can Be Computed with Indefinite Causal Structure?
items.title_zh: 不定因果结构能计算什么？
items.abstract_en: Can quantum computation become more powerful when operations do not need to follow a definite causal order? We study this question in the process matrix formalism of Oreshkov et al. (Nature Communications, 2012), which allows quantum operations to be connected without a fixed global order. In the computational model, a quantum circuit succinctly describes a process matrix, and the algorithm is given access to its generated channel, with computational cost measured by the size of the generating circuit. We give polynomial-time algorithms in two settings. First, general process matrix computation suffices to solve every problem in $\textbf{NP}$. The valid processes used by our algorithm satisfy the purification postulate of Araújo et al. (Quantum, 2017), and their generated channels are unitary, although their generating circuits are not. Second, requiring the process matrices themselves to be pure, we give a polynomial-time algorithm for unique-sink orientation, a general problem capturing several longstanding computational problems in optimization. Our unitary generators are constructed explicitly and efficiently. Assuming that unique-sink orientation has no quantum polynomial-time algorithm, our result shows that indefinite causal order can provide computational power beyond $\textbf{BQP}$ within the process matrix formalism, even while preserving unitarity.

items.title_en: On the Quantum Chromatic Gap II
items.title_zh: 论量子色隙 II
items.abstract_en: We confirm a conjecture of the first author [SODA'26] on a strong form of pseudo-telepathy for Khot's $d$-to-$1$ games: for every $d\geq 4$, every $ε>0$, and every $k\in\mathbb N$, there is a $d$-to-$1$ label-cover game of classical value less than $ε$ that admits a perfect quantum strategy using finite-dimensional shared entanglement with measurement contexts of radius at least $k$. As a consequence, there exist graphs whose quantum chromatic number $χ_q$ is $3$ and whose classical chromatic number $χ$ is arbitrarily large. This is the first improvement on the quantum chromatic gap since the work of Brassard, Cleve, and Tapp [Phys. Rev. Lett.'99], which produced graphs for which $χ$ grows exponentially in $χ_q$. To prove the conjecture, we proceed as follows. We start with a ``stretched'' version of the Mermin--Peres magic square, obtained by spacing out its equations and linking them with additional long equation wires. This operation increases the radius of the initial measurement contexts of a perfect quantum strategy for the game, while preserving classical unsatisfiability. We then apply parallel repetition to make the classical value small, and we turn the system into a pseudo-telepathic multi-layered Kneser hypergraph via a PCP construction of Dinur, Guruswami, Khot, and Regev [STOC'03]. Finally, we feed the resulting hypergraph into the reduction of Fei, Minzer, and Wang from hypergraph colouring to $4$-to-$1$ games, we establish quantum completeness of this reduction, and we show that it preserves context radius.

items.title_en: Algebraic strong-to-weak symmetry breaking and partial decodability in the surface code
items.title_zh: 表面码中的代数性强-弱对称破缺与部分可解码性
items.abstract_en: Coherent noise can give rise to unconventional regimes of quantum information recovery and mixed-state order. We study these phenomena in two settings related by Wegner duality: the triangular-lattice surface code subject to single-qubit Pauli-$Z$ rotations followed by syndrome measurements, and a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ paramagnet subject to strongly symmetric decoherence. Increasing the rotation angle drives a transition from a decodable phase to a \emph{partially decodable} critical phase in the code, and from a strongly symmetric phase to a phase with \emph{algebraic} $\mathbb{Z}_2$ strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) in the dual paramagnet. We develop a common description of these phenomena in terms of a weakly coupled $\mathrm{SO}(n)$ nonlinear sigma model in the replica limit $n\to1$. Taking this replica limit analytically, we derive universal signatures of the critical phase: an optimal Pauli decoding fidelity that approaches a universal function of the system's aspect ratio in the thermodynamic limit, and a dual fidelity correlator that decays as a universal power law. These observables relate to correlations of twist operators in the sigma model description. Large-scale numerical simulations confirm these analytical predictions. We also argue that the algebraic SWSSB phase cannot be realized by any Pauli dephasing channel acting on the $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ paramagnet. We probe this "non-classical" character through the output state's sensitivity to well-separated $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ fluxes inserted in the initial state, which reveals persistent coherence between distinct $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ charge trajectories at long distances.

items.title_en: Grow, Compress, and Perturb: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Pathway to Scalable Quantum Chemistry on Quantum Computers
items.title_zh: 生长、压缩与微扰：面向可扩展量子化学计算的混合量子-经典路径
items.abstract_en: While Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) variants are among leading candidates for electronic structure calculations on quantum computers, gradient-based operator selection limits their scalability. To solve this, we introduce the Hamiltonian-gradient-free VULCAN (Variational Upbuilding, Layered Compression, Adaptive N-body perturbation) layered VQE framework. Our method dynamically generates ansatz operators using Variational Double Bracket Flow (VDBF) equations. Combined with a linearly scaling minimal complete pool, it creates a pool 4-12 times smaller than QEB (Qubit-Excitation-Based) pools. By appending entire layers simultaneously, Hamiltonian gradient measurements are completely eliminated. Circuit depth is managed via a grow-then-compress scheme using efficient state-overlap measurements, and qubit requirements are reduced by projecting the Hamiltonian onto a dominant-determinant subspace. Using high-performance emulation up to 32 logical qubits, we achieve chemical accuracy at just 5-20% of the measurement cost of batched ADAPT-VQE for hydrogen chains, BeH2 and H2O. For the 32-qubit C3H6, where batched ADAPT-VQE does not reach chemical accuracy, a single VULCAN layer combined with a GPU-accelerated stochastic Epstein-Nesbet (ENPT2) correction does. This stochastic ENPT2 post-processing step enables early termination at chemical accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 变分量子本征求解器（VQE）的各类变体是量子计算机上进行电子结构计算的主要候选方案，但基于梯度的算符选择限制了其可扩展性。为此，我们提出无需哈密顿量梯度的 VULCAN 分层 VQE 框架（变分增建、分层压缩、自适应 N 体微扰）。该方法利用变分双括号流（VDBF）方程动态生成拟设算符，配合线性规模的最小完备池，使算符池比 QEB 池小 4–12 倍；通过整层同时追加，彻底消除了哈密顿量梯度的测量。电路深度借助高效的态重叠测量以“先生长后压缩”策略控制，并通过将哈密顿量投影到主导行列式子空间来降低量子比特需求。在多达 32 个逻辑量子比特的高性能模拟上，对氢链、BeH2 和 H2O 达到化学精度，测量成本仅为批量 ADAPT-VQE 的 5–20%；对于批量 ADAPT-VQE 无法达到化学精度的 32 量子比特 C3H6，单个 VULCAN 层配合 GPU 加速的随机 Epstein-Nesbet（ENPT2）修正即可达标，这一后处理步骤使计算可在达到化学精度时提前终止。
items.highlight_zh: 免梯度分层 VQE 框架，测量成本降至 ADAPT-VQE 的 5–20%。
items.digest_zh:
【研究问题】在量子计算机上计算分子电子结构，主流路线是 VQE 及其变体（如 ADAPT-VQE）。这类方法每轮都要测量哈密顿量梯度来决定下一层加什么算符，测量开销大、难以扩展到更大体系，成为走向实用量子化学的瓶颈。

【方法】作者提出 VULCAN 框架，核心思路是“不测梯度也能选算符”：用变分双括号流（VDBF）方程动态生成拟设算符，并构造一个规模随体系线性增长的最小完备算符池，比常规 QEB 池小 4–12 倍。他们一次追加整层算符，从而完全跳过梯度测量；再用“先生长后压缩”的策略，通过高效的态重叠测量控制电路深度；同时把哈密顿量投影到由主导行列式构成的子空间，减少所需量子比特数。最后可选地叠加 GPU 加速的随机 Epstein-Nesbet 二阶微扰（ENPT2）修正。

【结果】在最多 32 个逻辑量子比特的模拟中，对氢链、BeH2、H2O 均达到化学精度，而测量成本仅为批量 ADAPT-VQE 的 5–20%。对 32 量子比特的 C3H6，批量 ADAPT-VQE 达不到化学精度，但单层 VULCAN 加随机 ENPT2 后处理即可达到；该后处理还允许在精度达标时提前终止，节省后续线路开销。

【意义】这项工作把“梯度测量”这一主要瓶颈绕开，同时压缩算符池、电路深度和量子比特需求，为在含噪声中等规模量子设备上做可扩展的量子化学计算提供了一条更省资源的混合量子-经典路径。

items.title_en: Quasi-Phases of Quantum Matter
items.title_zh: 量子物质的准相
items.abstract_en: Within quantum many-body phase diagrams, continuous transition lines can appear and then terminate. However, it has remained unclear whether the neighboring regimes can be meaningfully described as distinct phases, akin to water and vapour, since any sharp characterization would have to go beyond the usual notion of phases of matter. We answer this in the affirmative by introducing quasi-phases: gapped regimes near a critical point that are connected in the broader phase diagram, but not by any gapped path accessible from small perturbations of the critical theory. The physical consequences include interface modes between regimes in the same phase of matter. More striking still, describing both the extended critical line and the gapped path connecting the regimes requires a bigger multicritical parent theory. In spin-chain examples with continuous terminating lines with central charge $c=1$, we find multicritical $c=3/2$ and $c=9/5$ orbifolds describing so-called 'quotient symmetry protected' and 'representation symmetry protected' topological phenomena. While one-dimensional symmetry-protected topological phases are labeled by projective representation classes, these quasi-phases can have interface modes carrying higher-dimensional linear representations. We turn this into a constructive principle through a weakening of the Lieb-Schultz-Mattis anomaly. Supporting distinct quasi-phases makes an unnecessary critical point infrared-necessary, even if it is unnecessary at the ultraviolet scale. This condition is more restrictive than simply having a codimension-one critical line, revealing richer structure within phases of matter than their conventional classification suggests.

items.title_en: On the gauge-invariant orbital angular momentum of vector optical vortices in the paraxial approximation and beyond
items.title_zh: 论傍轴近似及超越傍轴近似下矢量光学涡旋的规范不变轨道角动量
items.abstract_en: In this paper we present a gauge-invariant formalism for describing the spin and orbital angular momenta of scalar and vector optical vortices. The correction term, arising from consistent incorporation of the transverse vector potential's nonlocality, restores gauge invariance and makes it possible to separate the total angular momentum into spin and orbital components. We propose a method for calculating the orbital and spin angular momenta of multimode vector vortex fields and show that the orbital angular momentum of such beams contains two qualitatively different components. The polarization-independent contribution to the orbital angular momentum is related to the topological charge that determines the order of the phase singularity, while the polarization-dependent one is proportional to the helical topological charge that determines the spatial inhomogeneity of the polarization. We also discuss the quantization procedure for fields with spatially inhomogeneous polarization in terms of modes with a helical topological charge, and examine the limits of applicability of the proposed formalism.

items.title_en: Using domain walls to benchmark fast quantum anneals
items.title_zh: 利用畴壁对快速量子退火进行基准测试
items.abstract_en: We consider the distribution of domain walls arising in ground states of frustrated 1-dimensional Ising spin chains with anti-parallel boundary spins. For ideal chains, a sine-squared particle-in-a-box distribution of domain walls is expected in the quantum setting, and a uniform distribution expected classically. However, for chains with random imperfections, prior work [Chancellor et al., npj Quantum Inf. 8, 73, 2022] found that the distribution in a physical implementation corresponded to neither. Instead, the domain wall distribution forms a U-shaped profile arising from a classical model with random fields, where the combination of averaging over these fields and thermal averaging produces the characteristic U-shape. With D-Wave's newer fast anneal feature, we access anneal times shorter than the coherence time and observe the expected coherent quantum behavior in the form of a sine-squared distribution. For the shortest available anneal time, the dynamics have not yet reached the sine-squared shape and instead display a different U-shape in the middle of the chains.
